verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents outbound automatic user provisioning, where changes to Workspace accounts sync to third-party apps such as Office 365, which covers the app-assignment side. The Directory API, Cloud Identity API, Apps Script automation and dynamic groups give building blocks an admin could script into joiner/mover/leaver flows. Nothing shows the HRIS acting as the source of truth with changes flowing into the directory automatically, so that would need custom integration work. Missing for 10: native HRIS connector or inbound SCIM provisioning into the directory, documented automated joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle handling, attribute-driven app assignment tied to HR data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
